decisions.reason: The promised highest-weight structure of the genuine full parabolic category was proved only in integral central summands: old F5 and step 1.5 require a dot-dominant integral maximum kappa, and parts (2)-(4) leave nonintegral Levi-dominant labels without projective flags and higher-standard kernels. This is a proof-scope gap, not a counterexample to the theorem. Repaired by a finite integer cutoff within each zeta-eigenvalue coset, then the existing PBW, graded-summand, reciprocity and kernel arguments apply to every central character.

reviews.reason: Locally checked all 13 final steps. For eta in the finite label set Sigma_chi, d=max{(nu-eta)(zeta) in Z: nu in Sigma_chi} exists and contains zero; every weight in eta(zeta)+Z is bounded by d. Truncated parabolic induction represents exact Levi Hom, and its central projection contains the labelled projective cover as a grading-preserving summand. Bounded graded freeness yields finite generalized-standard flags; Hom/Ext counting and extension swaps give reciprocity and higher-standard kernels. Finite triangularity gives bases and character injectivity. Parts (2)-(4) now include all Levi-dominant weights and every central summand, with finite-support direct sum and possible disconnectedness explicit. Integral claims and AC are retained. This is local review of the repair, not independent review.
